newsitem.title: USA: LeaRonal confident on FY earnings.
newsitem.headline: LeaRonal confident on FY earnings.

text.p: LeaRonal Inc said Monday it was "confident" earnings for the full fiscal year will equal or exceed last year's results.
LeaRonal reported net income of $15.6 million, or $1.74 per share, for the 1996 fiscal year ended February 29, 1996.
The company's 1997 fiscal year ends February 28.

LeaRonal reported net income of $4.57 million, or $0.52 per share, for the third quarter ended November 30, 1996, compared to net income of $4.13 million, or $0.46 per share, for the third quarter ended November 30, 1995.
